nodes.name: Conjecture 5.22: Conjecture
nodes.statement: A ${\mathbb{Q}}$-Fano variety $X$ is K-polystable if and only it is  reduced uniformly K-stable.

nodes.name: Conjecture 4.18: Conjecture
nodes.statement: Let $X$ be a ${\mathbb{Q}}$-Fano variety with $\delta(X)\le 1$, and $v$ a (quasi-monomial) valuation compute $\delta(X)$, then the graded ring ${\rm gr}_vR$ is finitely generated.

nodes.name: Theorem 8.3: Projectivity
nodes.statement: The restriction of $\lambda_{\rm CM}$ on any proper subspace of $X^{\rm Kps}_{n,V}$ whose points parametrize reduced uniformly K-stable Fano varieties, is ample. In particular,  $\lambda_{\rm CM}|_{\overline{X}^{\rm Kps, sm}_{n,V}}$ is ample.

nodes.name: Conjecture 3.15: Conjecture
nodes.statement: Let $X$ be a $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano variety. If $\delta(X)\le 1$, then there is a special test configuration ${\mathcal{X}}$ with the induced divisorial valuation  $E$ (see Lemma 3.3)  such that $\delta(X)=\delta_X(E)=\delta(X_0)$, where $X_0$ is the degeneration.

nodes.name: Conjecture 8.1: Conjecture
nodes.statement: Any family of K-semistable Fano varieties over a punctured curve $C^{\circ}=C\setminus \{0\}$, after a possible finite base change, can be filled in over $0$ to a family of K-semistable Fano varieties over $C$.
